format: custom renderer authoring data; not automatically loaded by Minecraft
base_render: Use original active-resource-pack celestial texture and original sky-quad UVs. Do not replace the sprite with a painted approximation.
overlay_render: Add violet cracks in the same UVs; preserve brightness. Clip overlay by the base alpha AND visible brightness mask, because black sky pixels can have alpha 255.
visible_mask: baseAlpha * clamp((max(baseRGB)-0.04)/0.12,0,1); compute in linear color if possible
moon_phase_rule: Use current native phase texture, not legacy moon_phases.png atlas. New moon can have no visible target pixels; do not fabricate a full moon.
color_rule: Do not multiply the whole celestial sprite by purple. Original white/gold/gray pixels remain visible.
destroyed_state: Hide the original body only for clients affected by the event; render UV fragments in the same apparent sky location.
targeting: Use the actual client celestial sky transform for each visible body. Test view direction against its visible quad/alpha mask and terrain occlusion; sun/moon are not ordinary entities.
